title: Revelation Chapter 22 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Revelation chapter 22 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Revelation Chapter 22 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Revelation Chapter 22.

questions.question: In Revelation 22, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: A pure river of water of life
The throne of God and of the Lamb
questions.correctAnswer: A pure river of water of life
questions.explanation: The pure river of water of life is mentioned first in Revelation 22:1.

questions.question: What does the tree of life yield every month?
questions.explanation: The tree of life is described as bearing twelve manner of fruits in Revelation 22:2.

questions.question: What shall there be no more of in Revelation 22?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:3 states that there shall be no more curse.

questions.question: Who shall serve in the presence of God and the Lamb?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:3 mentions that his servants shall serve him.

questions.question: What will they see in Revelation 22:4?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:4 states that they shall see his face.

questions.question: What will be in the foreheads of the servants?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:4 notes that his name shall be in their foreheads.

questions.question: What will there be no need for in Revelation 22:5?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:5 states that they need no candle.

questions.question: Who gives them light in Revelation 22:5?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:5 mentions that the Lord God giveth them light.

questions.question: How long shall they reign according to Revelation 22:5?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:5 states that they shall reign for ever and ever.

questions.question: What does the angel show to the servants in Revelation 22:6?
options: The things which must shortly be done
questions.correctAnswer: The things which must shortly be done
questions.explanation: In Revelation 22:6, the angel is sent to show unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.

questions.question: What is blessed according to Revelation 22:7?
options: He that keeps the sayings of the prophecy
questions.correctAnswer: He that keeps the sayings of the prophecy
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:7 states that blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.

questions.question: True or False: The throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in the new city.
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:3 states that the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it.

questions.question: True or False: There will be night in the new city.
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:5 clearly states that there shall be no night there.

questions.question: True or False: The angel shows the servants the history of the world.
questions.explanation: The angel shows the servants the things which must shortly be done, as stated in Revelation 22:6.

questions.question: True or False: The leaves of the tree are for the eating of the nations.
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:2 states that the leaves are for the healing of the nations, not for eating.

medium.title: Revelation Chapter 22 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Revelation Chapter 22 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What did John do when he saw and heard the things in Revelation?
questions.explanation: John fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed him these things (Revelation 22:8).

questions.question: What does Revelation 22:9 promise will happen if someone worships God instead of the angel?
questions.explanation: The angel instructs John to worship God, indicating that true worship is directed to God alone (Revelation 22:9).

questions.question: What should not be done to the sayings of the prophecy of this book according to Revelation 22:10?
questions.explanation: The angel tells John to seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book because the time is at hand (Revelation 22:10).

questions.question: What does Revelation 22:11 imply about the state of individuals?
questions.explanation: The verse indicates that those who are unjust or righteous will continue in their respective states (Revelation 22:11).

questions.question: According to Revelation 22:12, what is promised to those who work?
questions.explanation: Jesus states that He comes quickly and brings His reward to give every man according to his work (Revelation 22:12).

questions.question: What title does Jesus declare Himself in Revelation 22:13?
questions.explanation: Jesus identifies Himself as Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, emphasizing His eternal nature (Revelation 22:13).

questions.question: What is the blessing promised in Revelation 22:14?
options: Right to the tree of life
questions.correctAnswer: Right to the tree of life
questions.explanation: Blessed are those who do His commandments, as they will have the right to the tree of life (Revelation 22:14).

questions.question: How does Revelation 22:6 affirm the trustworthiness of the messages?
questions.explanation: The angel emphasizes that these sayings are faithful and true, reinforcing their reliability (Revelation 22:6).

questions.question: What does Revelation 22:7 emphasize about keeping the sayings?
questions.explanation: The verse pronounces a blessing on those who keep the sayings of the prophecy (Revelation 22:7).

questions.question: What does the absence of night symbolize in Revelation 22:5?
questions.explanation: The absence of night indicates that the Lord God gives them light, symbolizing eternal peace and presence (Revelation 22:5).

questions.question: In Revelation 22:4, what will the servants see?
questions.explanation: The servants shall see His face, symbolizing direct communion with God (Revelation 22:4).

questions.question: According to Revelation 22:3, what will there be no more of?
questions.explanation: The verse states that there shall be no more curse, indicating a restoration of creation (Revelation 22:3).

questions.question: True or False: The angel told John to worship him.
questions.explanation: The angel instructed John not to worship him but to worship God (Revelation 22:9).

questions.question: True or False: The tree of life is mentioned in Revelation 22:2 as yielding fruit every month.
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:2 describes the tree of life bearing twelve manner of fruits, yielding its fruit every month.

questions.question: True or False: The Lord God will not provide light in the new city according to Revelation 22:5.
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:5 states that the Lord God gives them light, meaning there will be divine illumination in the new city.

hard.title: Revelation Chapter 22 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Revelation Chapter 22.

questions.question: Which group is mentioned as being without in Revelation 22:15?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:15 states, 'For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.' This verse lists dogs among those outside the New Jerusalem.

questions.question: Who testifies about the things in the churches according to Revelation 22:16?
questions.explanation: In Revelation 22:16, it is stated, 'I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches.' This indicates that Jesus is the one who sends the angel.

questions.question: What invitation is extended in Revelation 22:17?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:17 includes the invitation, 'And the Spirit and the bride say, Come.' This emphasizes the call to those who hear.

questions.question: What will happen to anyone who adds to the words of the prophecy according to Revelation 22:18?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:18 warns, 'If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book.' This indicates a severe consequence.

questions.question: What is promised to those who take away from the words of the book according to Revelation 22:19?
options: They will lose their part in the book of life
questions.correctAnswer: They will lose their part in the book of life
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:19 says, 'God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city.' This indicates a loss of eternal life.

questions.question: What does Jesus declare about His return in Revelation 22:20?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:20 states, 'Surely I come quickly.' This emphasizes the imminent return of Jesus.

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'pothē' in Revelation 22:17 mean?
questions.explanation: 'Pothē' translates to 'to desire' in this context, highlighting the longing for spiritual fulfillment.

questions.question: Which literary device is used in Revelation 22:17 where the Spirit and the bride invite others?
questions.explanation: The invitation 'Come' is repeated, emphasizing the call to those who hear and are thirsty, which is a form of repetition.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the theme of the invitation to the thirsty found in Revelation 22:17?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 55:1 states, 'Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters.' This parallels the invitation in Revelation 22:17.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the theme of the Tree of Life found in Revelation 22:2?
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:9 mentions the Tree of Life in the Garden of Eden, which is echoed in Revelation 22:2 as part of the New Jerusalem.

questions.question: What comes before Revelation 22:15 regarding who is outside the city?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:14 speaks of those who can enter: 'Blessed are they that do his commandments.' This implies that the unclean are excluded.

questions.question: What is stated immediately after Revelation 22:20 about the grace of Jesus?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:21 concludes with 'The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all,' indicating that His grace is offered universally.

questions.question: In Revelation 22:18, what does the phrase 'these things' refer to?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:18 warns against adding to the words of the prophecy of this book, indicating that 'these things' refer specifically to the book's prophecies.

questions.question: True or False: Revelation 22:21 emphasizes the importance of grace.
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:21 states, 'The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all,' emphasizing the importance of grace for all believers.

questions.question: True or False: Revelation 22:19 indicates that taking away from the prophecy has no consequences.
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:19 states that taking away from the words will result in losing one's part out of the book of life, indicating serious consequences.

theological.title: Revelation Chapter 22 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Revelation Chapter 22 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Revelation 22:3 teach about the nature of salvation and the removal of sin's consequence?
options: There shall be no more curse and the servants of God shall serve Him in His presence
Salvation is only a future hope with no present effect
The curse remains but is mitigated by works of righteousness
The throne of God will be hidden from the redeemed
questions.correctAnswer: There shall be no more curse and the servants of God shall serve Him in His presence
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:3 states 'And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him,' teaching the doctrine of the final removal of the curse and the eternal service to God in His presence.

questions.question: What doctrine concerning Christ's identity and eternal nature does Revelation 22:13 affirm?
options: Christ is the Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last
Christ is a created being subordinate to God the Father
Christ's identity is limited to His earthly ministry
Christ is a symbolic figure without eternal existence
questions.correctAnswer: Christ is the Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:13 declares 'I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last,' affirming the doctrine of Christ’s eternal deity and sovereign lordship over all time.

questions.question: What doctrine about divine judgment and human responsibility is taught in Revelation 22:11?
options: The persistence in one's moral state at judgment is affirmed—unjust remain unjust, righteous remain righteous
God will change everyone's moral state regardless of their choices
All people will eventually become righteous
Human actions have no bearing on their eternal state
questions.correctAnswer: The persistence in one's moral state at judgment is affirmed—unjust remain unjust, righteous remain righteous
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:11 states 'He that is unjust, let him be unjust still... and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still,' teaching the doctrine that final judgment confirms the moral state of individuals.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Revelation 22:6 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:6 shows God's sovereignty as He sends His angel to reveal what must shortly be done, demonstrating His control over prophetic revelation and redemptive history.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Revelation 22:5 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:5 says 'they shall reign for ever and ever,' highlighting God's attribute of eternality in the everlasting reign of the redeemed.

questions.question: How does Revelation 22:1 connect to the broader biblical theme of living water in the Old and New Testaments?
options: It fulfills the promise of the river of living water flowing from God's throne providing eternal life
It introduces a new water symbol unrelated to previous Scripture
It contradicts the idea of water as a symbol of life in the Old Testament
It suggests water is a physical necessity but not spiritual
questions.correctAnswer: It fulfills the promise of the river of living water flowing from God's throne providing eternal life
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:1 portrays the pure river of water of life proceeding from God's throne, fulfilling Old Testament imagery (Ezekiel 47) and Jesus’ promise of living water (John 7:38) symbolizing eternal life.

questions.question: In what way does Revelation 22:17's invitation relate to the universal call of salvation in Scripture?
options: The Spirit and the bride invite all who hear and thirst to freely receive the water of life
Salvation is limited to a select group and exclusive
The invitation only applies to the Jewish people
The call to salvation is conditioned on works
questions.correctAnswer: The Spirit and the bride invite all who hear and thirst to freely receive the water of life
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:17 extends a universal invitation consistent with biblical teaching on the free offer of salvation to all who respond, echoing John 7:37 and Isaiah 55:1.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Revelation 22:18 and 22:19 teach about the integrity of Scripture?
options: The prophecy of this book must not be added to or taken from, emphasizing scriptural inerrancy and authority
The prophecy is flexible and open to additions or deletions
Only parts of the prophecy are authoritative
The text encourages reinterpretation over preservation
questions.correctAnswer: The prophecy of this book must not be added to or taken from, emphasizing scriptural inerrancy and authority
questions.explanation: Verses 22:18-19 warn against adding or taking away from the prophecy, teaching the doctrine of the inviolable authority and inerrancy of Scripture.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Revelation 22:4 and 22:14 teach about the believer’s relationship to God in the eschaton?
options: Believers will see God's face and have His name on their foreheads, granting them right to the tree of life and entrance into the city
Believers will remain separated from God and denied access to the tree of life
The relationship with God will be indirect and mediated
Believers must earn the right to see God through works
questions.correctAnswer: Believers will see God's face and have His name on their foreheads, granting them right to the tree of life and entrance into the city
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:4 and 22:14 together teach that the redeemed enjoy direct fellowship with God (seeing His face) and bear His name, which grants access to eternal life symbolized by the tree of life and entry into the New Jerusalem.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Revelation 22:12 and 22:7 teach about Christ’s return and the believer’s response?
options: Christ will come quickly with rewards, and blessing comes to those who keep the sayings of the prophecy
Christ’s return is delayed and uncertain, requiring no particular response
Believers should ignore the prophecy and focus on other teachings
Rewards are based on human merit apart from Christ
questions.correctAnswer: Christ will come quickly with rewards, and blessing comes to those who keep the sayings of the prophecy
questions.explanation: Verses 22:12 and 22:7 emphasize the imminent return of Christ with rewards and the blessing for those who keep the prophetic words, teaching the doctrine of watchfulness and obedience in light of Christ’s return.

questions.question: Skeptics claim that Revelation 22:11 teaches that God's judgment is arbitrary and unchanging regardless of repentance. What does Revelation 22:11 actually teach?
options: It teaches that at the final judgment, individuals' moral states are confirmed rather than arbitrarily changed
It teaches that God arbitrarily condemns people without regard to their deeds
It says repentance can change one's final judgment after death
It denies any final judgment altogether
questions.correctAnswer: It teaches that at the final judgment, individuals' moral states are confirmed rather than arbitrarily changed
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:11 states 'He that is unjust, let him be unjust still... and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still,' indicating the finality of judgment reflecting one’s established moral state, not arbitrariness.

questions.question: What doctrine about Christ’s messianic identity and eschatological role does Revelation 22:16 teach?
options: Jesus is the root and offspring of David and the bright and morning star, affirming His messianic lineage and divine glory
Jesus is purely human with no divine titles
Jesus’ messianic role is limited to the Old Testament
Jesus is a mythological figure with no historical basis
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus is the root and offspring of David and the bright and morning star, affirming His messianic lineage and divine glory
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:16 identifies Jesus as both root and offspring of David and the bright and morning star, affirming the biblical doctrine of His messianic Davidic lineage and divine glory.

questions.question: What doctrine concerning the final destiny of the unrighteous is taught by Revelation 22:15?
options: Those outside the city include dogs, sorcerers, whoremongers, murderers, idolaters, and liars, indicating exclusion from eternal blessing
All people will enter the holy city regardless of deeds
Unrighteousness is temporary and does not affect final destiny
Only idolaters are excluded from eternal life
questions.correctAnswer: Those outside the city include dogs, sorcerers, whoremongers, murderers, idolaters, and liars, indicating exclusion from eternal blessing
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:15 lists those excluded from the city, teaching the doctrine of eternal separation of the unrighteous from the blessings of the New Jerusalem.

questions.question: What doctrine about the certainty of Christ’s return and the eschatological hope does Revelation 22:20 teach?
options: Christ testifies He is coming quickly, affirming the certainty and imminence of His return
Christ’s return is symbolic and not literal
The timing of Christ’s return is unknown and indefinite
Christ has already returned in a completed sense
questions.correctAnswer: Christ testifies He is coming quickly, affirming the certainty and imminence of His return
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:20 records Jesus’ own testimony 'Surely I come quickly,' affirming the doctrine of the literal, personal, and imminent return of Christ.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Revelation 22:2 and 22:14 teach about eternal life and access to the New Jerusalem?
options: The tree of life yields fruit monthly for healing nations and blessings come to those who do God's commandments granting them right to the tree of life and entry
Eternal life is given apart from obedience and access is universal
The tree of life is symbolic of judgment, not healing
Access to the city is based on ethnicity
questions.correctAnswer: The tree of life yields fruit monthly for healing nations and blessings come to those who do God's commandments granting them right to the tree of life and entry
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:2 speaks of the tree of life yielding fruit for healing, while 22:14 blesses those who keep God's commandments with right to the tree of life and city access, teaching the doctrine of covenant obedience and eternal healing.
